item.title: Ohio Releases 2025 Concealed Carry Report
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio — Ohio Attorney General Dave Yost has released the state’s 2025 concealed handgun licensing report, showing that 77,159 permits were issued across Ohio last year.
